project_name: Anna Cheng - Senior AI Product Designer Portfolio & Executive Platform
target_audience: Design Leadership, VP/Head of Design Recruiters, Executive Hiring Managers, Enterprise AI Founders
archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST meets ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY EDITORIAL (Executive Authority, Precision, Architectural Clarity, AI-Era Sophistication)
design_freedom: HIGH - Executive Editorial hybrid with high density interactive tools, scannable case studies, and live AI assistant

theme_strategy.dark_mode_rationale: Deep executive charcoal tone (#0D0E11) conveys authority, high-tech AI sophistication, and reduces eye strain while highlighting rich case study imagery and interactive data visualizers.
theme_strategy.light_mode_rationale: Warm museum paper tone (#F9F8F6) gives an editorial print magazine aesthetic suitable for formal executive presentation.

font_family_pairing.display_heading: Cabinet Grotesk / Cormorant Garamond / Playfair Display (Google Font / CDN fallback)

hierarchy.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.08] font-serif
hierarchy.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.eyebrow_label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] font-mono font-semibold text-amber-500 dark:text-amber-400

forbidden_colors: pure transparent headers without blur backdrop

navigation_and_header.style: Sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-border/60 transition-colors duration-200

public_home.hero_headline: I make complex, high-stakes products clear, including the AI inside them.
public_home.subtext: 30 years of UX/UI evolution — from early web software to enterprise AI agents. Based in Denver, CO.

ways_i_work_tracks.focus: Architecting multi-modal enterprise UIs, AI failure state designs, & high-stakes workflows.
Human-in-the-loop agentic systems, confidence scoring UIs, and explainable AI interactions.
Scaling design systems across cross-functional teams, mentoring 50+ designers, & strategic alignment.

case_study_format.placeholder_indicator: Metrics explicitly marked as [To Confirm] when appropriate for recruiter transparency.

interactive_features.ask_annas_ai: Floating or dedicated interactive AI streaming chat panel answering questions on Anna's experience, methodology, and philosophy.
interactive_features.job_description_matcher: Public tool where recruiters paste a Job Description and get an instant AI match score, relevant skills, and recommended case studies.
interactive_features.private_owner_portal: Secure area with Tailoring Tool (ATS keywords, bullet re-ordering), Inbox (chat queries, JD submissions), and 7-chapter Strategy Playbook.

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Glowing Amber/Indigo accent border on active case study cards and JD matcher panel
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/70 border border-slate-700/50 for floating AI agent widget
visual_enhancers.micro_textures: Subtle noise overlay (svg grain filter) to eliminate flat digital glare and give an editorial print texture
visual_enhancers.code_accents: Monospace tags with brackets e.g. [ROLE :: PRINCIPAL IC] and [STATUS :: PRODUCTION SHIPPED]

motion_and_interactions.framer_motion_stagger: Fade-in and subtle slide-up stagger for grid cards
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Hover lift -translate-y-1 with shadow glow transition
motion_and_interactions.prefers_reduced_motion: Respect system settings with fallback static layout

case_study_previews.title: Bank of America Enterprise AI Copilot

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: EVERY interactive element (buttons, links, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, chat items, private owner buttons) MUST include a clear kebab-case data-testid attribute.
testing_and_accessibility.wcag_compliance: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for body text, 3:1 for large display headers and buttons. Visible focus rings on keyboard navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette and typography rules specified above.
Construct the 3 'Ways I Work' tracks cleanly on the homepage with deep dive modals or direct links to filtered case studies.

Implement the live streaming AI assistant ('Ask Anna's AI') with pre-populated prompt suggestions (e.g., 'What is Anna's experience with AI failure modes?', 'How does Anna approach design leadership?').
Build the public Job Description Matcher tool with interactive file/text input, generating detailed keyword alignment, match score badge, and suggested case studies.
Build the private owner area with passcode/login, resume tailoring tool, inbox of incoming recruiter interactions, and 7-chapter strategy playbook with side TOC navigation.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, cards, and navigation links have unique data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop centered layouts; enforce asymmetric editorial bento grids.
Never use dark colors as high-contrast multi-stop gradients; use rich solid surfaces with 1px precise borders (#2A2D37).
Layered z-index control for sticky navigation, floating chat drawer, and modal overlays.
Do not use transparent background without backdrop blur filter on headers or overlays.
Ensure micro-interactions on hover, focus, and state transitions without using universal transition:all.
Include data-testid on all interactive and data display components.
